rootCause: The shared Done/Review later handler selected a run but scrolled and focused only the compact table; it neither opened the full-history disclosure nor activated Job History, and only the compact rows used historyJobId for highlighting.
implementation: The shared return-to-history handler synchronously opens the disclosure, activates the controlled history tab, records the selected run and exits the followed-run view before moving focus.
Focus targets the named non-live full-history region; the selected row is scrolled into view when mounted.
Full-history rows use aria-current and the existing TableRow selected-state styling.

An arbitrary older selected run resolves through the existing per-run query cache/API and is included only in full-history rows, with an explanatory range note. The paginated jobs list, limits, compact rows and pagination count calculations are unchanged.
Flattened keyed history rows keep row and details-button identity stable when a selected older run is inserted or later enters the paginated window.
Direct jobId initialization, followed-run URL synchronization, the always-mounted launch guide and shared detail-dialog focus restoration are unchanged.
